gen-dafont-visitor-gf-anek-telugu: Nostalgic from the first glance, Visitor gapes at the mouth of every e and keeps its ascenders short. Anek Telugu does the quieter job, its wide, open-hooked bowls carrying a clean, approachable sans text along.
gen-dafont-visitor-gf-anuphan: Visitor draws every line like one marker tip traced it, with gaping e mouths and short ascenders sitting over big bowls. Anuphan then reads smoothly, its round bowls and open curves leaving clear gaps.
gen-dafont-visitor-gf-arimo: Gap-mouthed and nostalgic, Visitor squeezes out strokes like toothpaste in one steady line. And where Visitor announces, Arimo informs, with a high mean line and spacious terminal gaps in its rounds.
gen-dafont-visitor-gf-armata: Visitor draws every stroke like drawn wire, with gaping e mouths and short ascenders above big bowls. Armata handles the text, spacing its characters generously and letting lowercase bodies fill most of the height.
gen-dafont-visitor-gf-athiti: Nostalgic and digital, Visitor gapes wide on every e while its ascenders stay short. Athiti keeps longer reading light, with a high mean line and an s you can see straight through.
gen-dafont-visitor-gf-atkinson-hyperlegi: Atkinson Hyperlegible reads clearly, with clipped capitals and wide-set terminals on its s. Visitor's wire-like strokes and gaping e mouths give the heading a digital edge that the body text quietly steadies.
gen-dafont-visitor-gf-biryani: Gaping mouths on every e give Visitor its nostalgic, digital look, strokes pulled like solder through a nozzle. Biryani takes over below, every e wide-eyed and every small counter unclogged.
gen-dafont-visitor-gf-blinker: Blinker holds its line thickness steadily, with open apertures and lowercase that fills most of the height. Yet beneath Visitor's gaping, nostalgic headings, paragraphs glide along easily and cleanly.
gen-dafont-visitor-gf-comme: Visitor cuts every stroke end as if from the same ribbon, with gaping e mouths and short ascenders. Comme's real draw is a smooth read with no clogged curves, lowercase filling most of the height.
gen-dafont-visitor-gf-duru-sans: Visitor runs uninterrupted monoline strokes with gaping e mouths and short ascenders. Duru Sans takes the longer reading, its wide openings and dominant lowercase bodies letting ascenders hardly show, so paragraphs feel modern and clean.
